offering_description.value: Weatherford provides equipment and services to energy operators for drilling, completing, producing from, servicing, and abandoning wells. Dedicated teams combine field equipment, digital tools, and project management to deliver work from planning through execution. It also offers energy transition solutions focused on reducing emissions and improving efficiency.

quotes.quote: Weatherford Integrated Services offers solutions tailored to the needs of our customers and the challenges of their projects. Our integrated management teams work collaboratively as extensions of your taskforce and partners in your success across well construction, production, and abandonment. As a result, we streamline operations from conception to completion and execute the right services with a comprehensive portfolio of technologies. Combining the best-fit project delivery model, goal-oriented service integration, and customer-centric project management, we elevate the customer experience and deliver results.
Lead the energy transition—cut emissions, boost efficiency, and deliver lasting value with breakthrough New Energy Solutions.
